image_description: A close-up view of a bicycle disc brake system. The image shows a perforated metal rotor (disc) with a wavy outer edge, mounted to a wheel hub with spokes visible in the background. A white fork leg is visible, with a black caliper assembly mounted to it. The caliper has adjustment knobs and hydraulic line connections. The rotor has a pattern of cutouts for ventilation and weight reduction.
